messages:
Ana (People Ops): @miguel payroll — Sam switched from CA -> OR mid-pay period. Final paycheck 3/12 shows CA withheld for whole period and OR withheld too. PTO payout appears double-withheld. Can you check PR-20260312-45? Link: https://payroll.internal/PR-20260312-45

Miguel (Payroll): On it. Do we have official state change effective date in HRIS?

Sam (Eng): I updated my address in Ripley on 2026-03-10 at ~4:20pm. PTO payout was requested 3/9.

Ana (People Ops): HR shows effective 2026-03-10 16:20 — screenshot uploaded to thread.

Miguel (Payroll): quick dump from payroll DB for emp 4789:
```
emp_id: 4789
pay_period: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-15
residence_state_on_cutoff: CA
hr_state_effective: 2026-03-10T16:20Z
withholdings:
 - state_CA: 86.24
 - state_OR: 45.60
earnings_breakdown:
 - reg_pay: 1200.00
 - pto_payout: 320.00
```

Miguel (Payroll): Looks like the cutoff used CA for regular earnings then OR tax was applied again to PTO payout line — duplicate total. Marking PR as manual-review.

payroll-bot: PR-20260312-45 flagged for manual tax reconciliation. ETA 2 days. :rotating_light:

Emily (HR): If payroll needs a form, Sam can sign OR withholding election. But retro adjustments typically go as payroll correction/refund.

Miguel (Payroll): Plan: 1) reverse erroneous withhold on off-cycle refund (net +86.24) processed 2026-03-19 2) re-run PTO payout tax using OR only, adjust employer liabilities 3) if year-end reporting impacted, process W-2C. I'll attach journal entries once ready.

Sam (Eng): Thanks — any timeline for receiving refunded amount? I have bills next week.

Miguel (Payroll): Refund on 3/19 off-cycle; you'll see separate line "State Tax Refund - CA" in paystub and separate ACH. Ping me if not there.

Ana (People Ops): I'll let Sam know status and ask them to upload OR withholding doc if needed.

Sam (Eng): Appreciate it. :pray:

Miguel (Payroll): tagging @Harper to confirm whether state tax engine should ingest HR change immediately on 3/10 or after cutoff.

Harper (Payroll Dev): The state mapping service consumes HR webhook. Cutoff job runs 03:00 UTC 3/10 — if HR update after 03:00 it won't be applied until next run. We should adjust cutover docs. Filed issue: #INF-987.

Ana (People Ops): Good to know — we'll update new-hire/state-change guidance to mention cutoff times.

Emily (HR): I'll add note to the change form and inform BAU hires.

Miguel (Payroll): Closing loop — will post final confirmation here after refund processed.
